Methyl groups (CH3) typically appear in the 13C NMR around 10-30 ppm, but they are usually distinct and appear at the lower end of this range (10-20 ppm for most methyl groups). The signals at 26.90, 26.18, and 34.54 ppm are more consistent with CH2 groups in a cyclic structure (like cyclohexyl).
